That Rajmohan Shaha died leaving 4 sons Mohabharat Shahs, Bhagabat Chandra Shaha, Basanta Kumar Shaha, Gakul Chandra Shaha as his heirs. That Bhagabat Chandra Shaha died leaving plaintiff No. 2 as his only son and as such he acquired /8/- annas share in the suit jote. Jogoballav Shaha, and Radhaballav Shaha and being in possession over their /4/- annas share sold to pro-defdt. Nos. 7-11 by registered kabalas. That Akhoy Kumar Shaha died leaving one son puff.
